data.name: Eloralintide
data.description: Selective, long-acting amylin receptor agonist administered SC QW at doses of 1.5 mg, 3 mg, 6 mg, or 9 mg for 64 weeks for body weight reduction in participants with overweight or obesity and T2D

data.name: Placebo
data.description: Matching placebo administered SC QW for 64 weeks

data.name: Oral antihyperglycemic medications (AHMs)
data.description: Stable background treatment for T2D consisting of diet/exercise alone or up to 3 oral AHMs (excluding incretins, except DPP-4i are allowed); participants must be on stable treatment for at least 90 days prior to screening

data.name: Lifestyle counseling (healthy nutrition and physical activity)
data.description: All participants receive lifestyle-modification counseling including healthy diet and physical activity guidance throughout the study, consistent with current guidelines for weight management

data.name: Diabetes education
data.description: Participants with T2D receive diabetes education consistent with guidelines for T2D management (American Diabetes Association-EASD 2022)

data.name: New antihyperglycemic medications
data.description: Initiation of new antihyperglycemic medications permitted per Section 6.9.1; insulin use for ≥14 consecutive days is prohibited

data.name: Insulin (rescue therapy)
data.description: Urgent use of short-term insulin in a hospital or closely monitored setting may be used as rescue therapy for severe, persistent hyperglycemia; study intervention must be temporarily interrupted when insulin is used as short-term rescue therapy

data.name: DXA scan
data.description: Dual-energy x-ray absorptiometry for body composition assessment at baseline (between Visits 2 and 3), Week 28 (Visit 10), and Week 64 (Visit 19) or early discontinuation

data.name: Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM)
data.description: Used in CGM substudy (Appendix 9) to evaluate 24-hour glucose profile for eloralintide versus placebo in individuals with obesity and/or overweight with T2D
